items.title: Branford Marsalis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: See ya’ll need to meet my wife.

ctx.x: He didn’t…. Hey Nicole. C’mon in. Come over here please. See ya’ll need to meet my wife. She’s really pretty and she’s smart too. She’s smart and she’s pretty. It’s better that way. She just got her Masters degree just two weeks ago. So she’s the only person in the house that has actual degrees. So clearly she’s the smartest one. Nicole: He says this with tongue firmly planted in his cheek.
No I’m not. That’s some bullshit. I’m serious. Anthony, Ken…. (introduces Nicole) Nicole: Nice to meet you.
